title: New tunable new_area_seed_tiles parsed via wrap-capable jint instead of the hardened jint_strict accessor
detail: The new boundary key loads through jint: an out-of-i32-range JSON integer wraps (e.g. 2^32+10 silently becomes 10) and a decimal silently truncates, passing the new range checks as valid data instead of failing fast (ODN-5/ODN-10), unlike jint_strict siblings.
recommended_fix: Parse new_area_seed_tiles (ideally the whole growth_groups block) via jint_strict, rejecting out-of-range integers/decimals naming the key; add the missing decimal/overflow loader test rows, matching cap_fraction_permille.
